summary: Walks a linked list of animation elements (head at this+0x204, next pointer at node+0x10) and, for each entry matching type id a2, adds an (a4, a5) offset to the X/Y position components of every vertex in the entry's vertex array, using a 48-byte stride. The vertex component base is a3-selectable: a3==0 updates components at data+32/+36, a3==1 updates at data+40/+44. Each updated entry has dirty bit 0x800 set at its flags field (v7[12]). Part of the pit crew animation update path invoked during camera/viewport render setup.

local_names.i: linked-list node being iterated (this[129] head, i[4] next)
local_names.v7: per-entry record pointer (base i[71]+8, stride 16 dwords)
local_names.v8: vertex data pointer from the entry (v7[1])
local_names.a2: entry type id the node entries are matched against
local_names.a4: X position offset added to each vertex
local_names.a5: Y position offset added to each vertex

operations.description: Outer traversal of the animation element linked list: start at the head this[129] (this+0x204) and follow the next pointer i[4] until null.
Per-node guard: the node's entry count i[70] must be > 0 before any entry records are walked (packet guard 0, this+0x32C).
Inner do-while over the node's entry records: advance v7 by 16 dwords per iteration, comparing each record's type id *(v7-1) against a2 to find matches.
Per-entry guard: the matched entry's vertex count *v7 must be > 0 before the vertex loop runs (packet guard 1, this+0x338).

Vertex update loop (a3==0 branch): iterate over the vertex array pointed to by the entry (this+0x33C) with a 48-byte stride, adding a4 to the X component (base data+32) and a5 to the Y component (base data+36).
Vertex update loop (a3==1 branch): same 48-byte-stride iteration but the X component base is data+40 and the Y component base is data+44.
Mark the entry dirty: set bit 0x800 in v7[12] (entry+0x30 flags; packet this+0x368) after its vertex offsets are updated.
Invoked by CameraViewportRenderSetup (0x004FBD70) as part of pit crew animation offset refresh during viewport render setup.

unresolved: The packet field table expresses the node/entry accesses as this-relative offsets (this+0x32C entry count, this+0x330 type id, this+0x338 vertex count, this+0x33C vertex data pointer, this+0x368 dirty flag) whereas the raw source accesses them relative to the node pointer i and the entry pointer v7; the exact relationship between `i`/`v7` and the `this` base is not proven here.
The read of this+0x224 reported by the packet is not visible as a distinct access in the raw decompiled source.
The vertex struct layout (48-byte stride, X/Y components at the a3-selected bases) is inferred from the update pattern, not from a named type.
